scientific_integrity: The symbolic argument is self-contained and does not claim independent validation; finite code tests are supplemental checks, not a proof of all parameter cases.
scientific_limitations: Exact Haar-uniform population distance moments on orthogonal three-dimensional flat tori only; general skew lattices, noisy estimators, and finite-sample confidence bounds are outside scope. Historical originality is provisional.
title: Three intrinsic distance moments reconstruct a rectangular flat three-torus, with sharp cubic-root stability
